text:
maria: Heads-up — Webinar 'Inference Unlocked' goes live next Tue 10am PT. Need social thread scheduling for X + LinkedIn, creative assets, and inbound routing plan. Target: ~1.5k registrants, baseline CTR goal 2.5%. Who can take scheduling + copy?

olivia: I can own scheduling. What cadence do we want for the week-of vs promo week? also need final hero image by Thu. :spiral_calendar_pad:

aj: I'll take creative. What sizes we need? and any brand lines to avoid?

maria: Week-of: 3 organic posts on X (tease, remind, last-call) + 2 LinkedIn post variants (company + personal). Promo week: 4 posts on X spread across timezone windows (8am PT, 11am PT, 2pm PT, 5pm PT). Hero: 1200x628; square for carousels 1080x1080.

olivia: Got it. I'll schedule with buffer windows: Tue 8am PT (tease), Wed 11am PT (reminder), Fri 5pm PT (last call). Also add livestream sticky for 10am PT start.

aj: Sending two headline options for review — short A/B style:
```
A) "Inference Unlocked: Ship LLM features with predictable latency & cost"
B) "Scale LLM inference without the infrastructure headache — join our webinar"
```
Which tone do we want? technical or product-forward?

sam: Growth note — we'll seed with a curated list of 2k high-intent users. Recommend P1 seed at Tue 8am PT and P2 re-seed Wed. Also recommend UTM tagging so SDRs can prioritize.

leo: SDR here — route inbound signups to #leads-sdr and create follow-up play: demo offer + 2-day nurture. Need UTM pattern and tag mapping.

aj: UTM example (use this in all social links):
```
?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_unlocked_q2&utm_content={variant}
```
Use {variant} = tease|remind|lastcall|lnkd_comp|lnkd_personal.

maria: Nice. Also we need a short 1-line benchmark narrative for the promo copy: "See how teams cut per-token cost by 3x while improving p95 latency — real customer case studies." Keep it claim-light.

olivia: Draft social copy (X) — short + CTA + link:
"Inference Unlocked — learn how teams get predictable LLM inference. Tue 10am PT. Save your spot → <link>{UTM}
A/B: add emoji for test."

aj: I'll drop hero + two square carousels by Thu noon. Can someone confirm final copy by Wed EOD?

sam: I'll export seedlist and share in GDrive by Wed morning. tagging: priority=high if org_size>100 and uses embeddings.

leo: Once registrant hits app, route to #leads-sdr and add slack note with tag + country. Can we automate with the webhook?

calendar-bot: Event created: "Inference Unlocked — Redwood" Tue 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Reminder set for 1h.

maria: Action items: olivia schedule posts, aj finish assets, sam deliver seedlist + utms, leo set SDR webhook. I'll pull CTAs and final landing link. Check back in Wed 11am sync. :thumbsup:

olivia: Confirmed — will post schedule and share calendar invites in the channel.

aj: Working on assets, will ping for copy review.

sam: Seedlist link posted: https://drive.redwood/growth/inference_unlocked_seedlist (will share access).

leo: I'll draft the SDR playbook snippet and post it to #sales-docs by Thu.

maria: Perfect. Thanks team — syncing Wed 11am in the marketing standup.
